audit.scope: Research-only primary-source audit of nine software-landscape records
audit.source_policy: Only project-owned repositories, tagged source, release pages, package metadata, project documentation, and project tests/examples. A related algorithm is not treated as decision-analytic VOI evidence.
audit.important_boundary: Pyro contrib.oed directly estimates information-theoretic EIG. None of the other records establishes conventional decision-analytic EVPI/EVSI or an incremental-utility VOI output. BoTorch/Trieste/Ax optimise acquisition/experiments; CausalML/EconML estimate causal effects; Orbit forecasts; VW/OBP evaluate or learn policies.

verified.api_schema: Python probabilistic-program model plus design tensor; EIG functions receive model, design, observation_labels and estimator-specific sample counts/guide arguments.
verified.options_defaults: Estimator signatures expose N/M sample sizes, guide, optim, num_steps and final_design; exact defaults should be extracted from the pinned signatures rather than retained as empty inventory fields.
verified.diagnostics_errors: Source validates incompatible estimator arguments and propagates Pyro/Torch model and shape failures; no standalone structured reporting API verified.
verified.outputs_reports: Tensor-valued EIG/loss results; no conventional decision-model, EVPI/EVSI, or report schema.
verified.examples_tests: Pinned tests/contrib/oed supplies executable estimator coverage.
verified.performance: Monte-Carlo/sample-count trade-off is intrinsic; no pinned benchmark claim audited.
verified.maintenance: 1.9.1 pinned release; do not describe dev-head as the reviewed revision.

corrections: Replace reviewed_revision dev-head and all dev-branch evidence with the immutable 1.9.1 commit above.
Populate functions, options/defaults, diagnostics and tensor outputs; retain the limitation that information gain is not conventional decision-analytic VOI.
